title: Legal Identification
description: A legal or tax identification document of a party, such as a taxpayer number. The role of the party (payer, invoice recipient, tax-document receiver) is defined by the schema that references this type. This is sensitive personal data: it MUST NOT be used as an authentication credential. Its number is write-only; a response can carry a masked last_digits hint instead.

type.description: Document type as an open, lowercase token: the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, a dot, and the document name. Open so a new jurisdiction needs no spec change. Non-exhaustive registry: br.cpf, br.cnpj, mx.rfc, ar.cuit, ar.cuil, cl.rut, uy.ci, co.nit, pe.ruc.

number.description: The document value as issued. Senders SHOULD use the issuer's canonical form. Core applies no per-jurisdiction format or check-digit validation; the receiving business or payment handler validates and MAY normalize common variants. Never returned in responses: a sender that still needs it MUST resend it.

last_digits.description: A masked hint of `number` that lets the buyer confirm which document is on file, set by the business. Contains only the trailing characters of `number`, at most 4 (documents are often alphanumeric). A business MUST omit it when `number` has 4 or fewer characters, so the full value is never echoed. Never sent by the platform.
